description: Start here for structure. Parses the STATIC IMPORT GRAPH from one entry file and returns the component tree: names, types (functional/class), state variables, parent-child edges. Scope: only components reachable from entryFile via static imports — lazy()/dynamic imports and other entry points are not in the tree, so absence from the tree does not mean absence from the app. Prefer analyze_codebase when you want tree + complexity + context in one call.

entryFile.description: Absolute path to the entry React component file (e.g., /path/to/App.jsx)

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth to traverse. Default: unlimited. Large responses are bounded previews with explicit omissions; use a displayed absolutePath as entryFile to expand a branch.

name: get_component_tree
